chunks: God has promised to those of you who believe and do the right, that He will surely make them successors in the earth, as He made successors those before them, and will surely establish for them their religion which He has chosen for them, and will surely change for them, after their fear, security; they will worship Me, not associating anything with Me. And whoever disbelieves after that, those are the defiantly disobedient.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for believers to become successors of the earth according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the doctrine of Imamate, where 'succession' (istikhlaf) is interpreted as the divine appointment of the Ahl al-Bayt to lead the community after the Prophet. It outlines a four-stage progression: from faith and action to political authority, then to the consolidation of religious law, and finally to the transition from fear to security (amniyyah), culminating in pure monotheism.
